scope: Adopted hidden judging inputs reconstructed from the official graph archive with fixed structure-preserving relabeling. Public development inputs retain their independent recipe and byte identity.

transform.seed_derivation: First eight SHA-256 bytes of seed_tag + colon + original output basename, interpreted as an unsigned big-endian integer. The stable seed tag retains its original algorithm bytes.
transform.ordering: Shuffle only the free-layer labels once, then shuffle the mapped edge list once; preserve fixed-layer labels and duplicate edges.

reference_binding: Every adopted reference key and B/K value is preserved. Free-layer relabeling preserves the one-sided crossing optimum. Raw official graphs are not the judging payload.
terms: The official exact-track archive has no explicit redistribution license. The separate MIT test-set license does not cover these files. Local reconstruction does not grant additional redistribution rights.
